sources.title: How Can Workflow Automation Simplify Multi-Service Apps Like Gojek?
sources.text: Daily reports: Generate summaries of completed orders, cancellations, and pending requests.
taskExcerpts: Daily reports: Generate summaries of completed orders, cancellations, and pending requests.

spans.text: I’m exploring how workflow automation can help businesses manage multi-service platforms similar to Gojek, where customers can book services such as rides, food delivery, grocery shopping, and home services through one platform. As these businesses grow, managing orders, service providers, customer notifications, and payments across different services can become complicated. Here are a few workflows I’m interested in exploring with n8n: Order notifications: Send automatic updates to customers when an order is placed, accepted, or completed. Service provider assignment: Route new requests to suitable providers based on service type and availability. Customer support: Use AI to categorize common customer questions and direct complex issues to a human support agent. Lead and order tracking: Store incoming requests in Google Sheets or a CRM and notify the operations team about pending orders. Daily reports: Generate summaries of completed orders, cancellations, and pending requests. I’d appreciate suggestions, recommended workflow patterns, or examples from anyone who has worked on similar automation projects.
Tap to visit: Gojek Clone - Launch Your Multiservice Platform in 5 Days

sources.text: I want to understand how n8n can help connect restaurant order systems, customer notifications, and delivery updates.
taskExcerpts: I want to understand how n8n can help connect restaurant order systems, customer notifications, and delivery updates.

spans.text: I’m exploring ways to automate workflows for a food delivery application similar to DoorDash. I want to understand how n8n can help connect restaurant order systems, customer notifications, and delivery updates. Can n8n receive new order data through webhooks, notify restaurants automatically, and send customers real-time status updates through messaging integrations? What would be the best workflow structure for handling order confirmations, delivery assignments, and failed notifications? I’d appreciate suggestions on suitable nodes and best practices for building a reliable workflow.

sources.title: n8n Summarize node documentation · product evidence
sources.text: Count : Count the total number of values in your input data. Count Unique : Count the number of unique values in your input data. Max : Find the highest numeric value in your input data. Min : Find the lowest numeric value in your input data. Sum : Add together the numeric values in your input data. Field : Enter the name of the field you want to perform the aggregation on. Fields to Split By Enter the name of the input fields that you want to split the summary by (similar to a group by statement). This allows you to get separate summaries based on values in other fields.
